title_sq: Ne Fresk, Shitet Vile 4 Kateshe, Ideale Per Banim Ose Investim!!!
description_sq: Ne Fresk, Shitet Vile 4 Kateshe, Ideale Per Banim Ose Investim!!! Kati perdhe organizohet nga dhoma e ndenjes, kendi i gatimit dhe tualeti, me nje siperfaqe 110 m2. Kati i pare organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 1 dhome gjumi, 1 tualet dhe ballkoni me siperfaqe 121.8 m2. Kati i dyte organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes, 2 dhoma gjumi, 2 tualete dhe ballkoni me siperfaqe 131.1 m2. Kati i trete organizohet nga salloni i ndenjes se bashku me kendin e gatimit, 2 dhoma gjumi, 1 tualet dhe ballkoni me siperfaqe 121.8 m2. Siperfaqja e parceles ndertimore eshte 252 m2 dhe siperfaqja totale e ndertimit per banim eshte 484.7 m2. Vila eshte totalisht e investuar, me sistem kondicionimi ne te gjitha katet, sistem kaldaje, dritare dopio xham me grila dhe rrjete, sistem per filtrimin e ujit me dy depozita te medha. Oborri eshte i bollshem ku mund te parkosh 2 automjete. Zona ku ndodhet prona ofron te gjitha facilitetet e nevojshme per nje jetese komode dhe te qete. Disponon dokumentacion te plote hipotekor.
title_en: In Fresk, 4-storey villa for sale, ideal for residence or investment!!!
description_en: In Fresk, 4-storey villa for sale, ideal for residence or investment!!! The ground floor is organized by the living room, the kitchen and the toilet, with an area of ​​110 m2. The first floor is organized by the living room together with the kitchen corner, 1 bedroom, 1 bathroom and balcony with an area of ​​121.8 m2. The second floor is organized by the living room, 2 bedrooms, 2 bathrooms and a balcony with an area of ​​131.1 m2. The third floor is organized by the living room together with the kitchen corner, 2 bedrooms, 1 bathroom and balcony with an area of ​​121.8 m2. The surface of the construction plot is 252 m2 and the total surface of the residential building is 484.7 m2. The villa is fully invested, with an air conditioning system on all floors, a boiler system, double-glazed windows with shutters and nets, a water filtration system with two large tanks. The yard is spacious where you can park 2 vehicles. The area where the property is located offers all the necessary facilities for a comfortable and quiet life. It has full mortgage documentation.
